name: form-hero
description: Form page hero: eyebrow, heading, copy, a check list and badges beside a white card holding a HubSpot form (classic v2 embed or the new-editor developer embed), with live's 'Form not loading?' fallback. light: a page hero on the colour wash (/get-a-quote-pro/). dark: white copy on a backdrop picture (/start-a-free-trial-email-only/). section: an in-page band with an h2 (the /barcode-labels/ order form).

variant.description: light: page hero on the soft colour wash. dark: white copy over the backdrop picture. section: a band inside a page (heading is an h2, softer padding).

anchor.description: id on the section, so links can jump to the form (letters, digits, hyphens).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title_tag.description: Heading level: h1 when the section is the page hero, h2 inside a page.

body.description: Paragraph under the heading. Line breaks are kept; wrap a run in **double asterisks** to bold it.

bullets.description: Check list under the copy. Plain strings; **double asterisks** bold a lead-in, e.g. **Solution Fit**: We'll match you…

badges.description: Badge images under the copy. Each: image (URL), alt, optional w and h (intrinsic px).

background.description: Backdrop picture URL, drawn cover-sized behind the section (light: the colour wash; dark: the brand picture).

form_title.description: Heading inside the form card, e.g. Create your account.

form_intro.description: Line under the card heading, e.g. Enter your work email to get started.

form_note.description: Small line under the form, e.g. No credit card required.

hubspot_portal.description: HubSpot portal ID (digits). The form renders only with a portal and a form ID.

hubspot_form.description: HubSpot form ID (GUID). Where the form sends the visitor after submitting is set in HubSpot.

hubspot_region.description: HubSpot region, e.g. na1 or na2. Picks the embed script host.

form_embed.description: v2: the classic embed (hbspt.forms.create, drawn unstyled into the page). developer: a form built in HubSpot's new editor, drawn as plain HTML by the developer embed script (live /start-a-free-trial-email-only/).

form_submit.description: v2 only: submit button text, set once the form is drawn. Empty keeps HubSpot's.

fallback_email.description: Email offered when the form fails to load (live: info@assetpanda.com). With fallback_phone, turns on live's 'Form not loading?' box, shown only if no form appears within 6 seconds.

fallback_phone.description: Phone number offered in the fallback box, e.g. (888) 928-6112. Hidden for international visitors (html.ap-intl), as on live.
